ResearchTabDef.label: Aeternus Faith
ResearchTabDef.generalDescription: Study sacred rites, Bonewright traditions, cathedrae, memory, entropy, and undeath.

ResearchProjectDef.label: faith rituals
ResearchProjectDef.description: Formalize the first Aeternus rites: sacred spaces, funerary observances, and the ritual language needed for deeper Bonewright practice.

ResearchProjectDef.label: ossanith traditions
ResearchProjectDef.description: Recover Ossanith rites of entropy, ossuary preservation, and skeletal command. This is the first Bonewright cathedra.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animara soulbinding
ResearchProjectDef.description: Study Animara methods of soulbinding, memory-guided undeath, and ancestor echoes that retain more than bare obedience.

ResearchProjectDef.label: choralum concordance
ResearchProjectDef.description: Study Choralum rites of spiritual harmony, healing through undeath, and choral stabilization of damaged souls.

ResearchProjectDef.label: shroudhymn oaths
ResearchProjectDef.description: Study Shroudhymn vows, sacred bindings, and task-bound spirits sworn to limited service beyond death.

ResearchProjectDef.label: voressai dissolution
ResearchProjectDef.description: Study Voressai rites of void entropy, incorporeal dissolution, and the dangerous unmaking of spiritual form.
